verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 59.4 (-1.1% in a day) and momentum is 46: prices are steady. 84s cost 1,100, 85s 2,500 and 86s 5,800. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-27T06:47:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Adrien Rabiot 86 Team of the week after its 58% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 17,000 coins. Now 18,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 58.0% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 15 of 25 so far, averaging +6.1% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Camilo Durán 85 Star Performer after its 53% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 90,000 coins. Now 67,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 52.5% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 9 of 17 so far, averaging +9.1% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 1,100 (1.33 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,500 (1.19 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,800 (1.41 coins per Item Score point), 87s 8,600 (1.56 coins per Item Score point), 88s 15,250 (1.84 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Kobbie Mainoo and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Kobbie Mainoo 89 Future Stars -61.4%; Jorrel Hato 85 Future Stars -61.3%; Rio Ngumoha 82 Team of the week -51.7%; Dayot Upamecano 89 Destined for Glory -50.2%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Tradeable 10x 80+ Upgrade SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 18K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
